card.name: Words just before a historical date or time
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs right before a specific date or clock time in a narrative of a past event, such as "on", "at", "born", "died" or "began". Seen in history and biography text.

modes.label: Event verb or preposition before a date
modes.description: A word like on, born, died or began that is about to be followed by a month and day.
modes.example: Adolf Hitler was<< born>> on April 20, 1

modes.label: Before a clock time
modes.description: A preposition or part of a time that leads into a time of day for a past event.
modes.example: The end came<< at>> around 9:30 a.m

card.writes: It pushes toward time-of-day and day-reference words such as 'Wednesday', 'yesterday' and 'local time'.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a date or time is given for a past event.
